title: Risk of Virological Failure After Switch to a Tenofovir‐Sparing Dual Therapy in Virologically Suppressed People With HIV and Past HBV Infection
abstract: ABSTRACT We compared the effectiveness of tenofovir (TFV)‐based triple regimens (TT) to TFV‐sparing dual therapies (DT) in virologically suppressed, HBsAg−/HBcAb+ people living with HIV (PLWH). We emulated a target trial including adults PLWH from five University Hospitals, with HBsAg−/HBcAb+ serostatus, starting a TT with unsuppressed serum HIV‐RNA and reaching HIV‐RNA 50 cp/mL or a single HIV‐RNA ≥ 200 cp/mL) were estimated through a weighted Kaplan–Meier estimator. Overall, 415 PLWH were eligible for study analysis: 71 (17.1%) started a DT (3TC‐based: 78.9%) during follow‐up. They were mainly men (329, 79.3%), with a median age of 48 years. In the weighted analysis, the estimated probabilities of VF were: 29.3% for DT and 29.9% for TT at 5 years (difference: 0.5%; 95% CI: −28.7, +21.6). A higher VF risk was seen in the subset of PLWH with undetectable HBsAb at the longest follow‐up available (4 years), independently of treatment group: 15.5% and 36.8% with DT and TT, respectively (difference: −21.3%; 95% CI: −30.3, −13.8). Switch to a TFV‐sparing DT, compared with continuing a TT, was not associated with an increased risk of VF in PLWH and prior HBV infection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study compared the effectiveness of tenofovir (TFV)-based triple regimens to TFV-sparing dual therapies in virologically suppressed people living with HIV who had past HBV infection (HBsAg−/HBcAb+).
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study emulated a target trial including 415 adults from five University Hospitals with HBsAg−/HBcAb+ serostatus who started a triple regimen with unsuppressed serum HIV-RNA and reached suppression. Participants were mainly men (329, 79.3%) with a median age of 48 years, and 71 (17.1%) started a dual therapy during follow-up.
analysis.methods: The probabilities of virological failure, defined as two consecutive HIV-RNA ≥ 50 cp/mL or a single HIV-RNA ≥ 200 cp/mL, were estimated through a weighted Kaplan–Meier estimator.
analysis.main_results: In the weighted analysis, the estimated probabilities of virological failure at 5 years were 29.3% for dual therapy and 29.9% for triple therapy (difference: 0.5%; 95% CI: −28.7, +21.6). A higher risk was seen in the subset with undetectable HBsAb at 4 years, with rates of 15.5% for dual therapy and 36.8% for triple therapy (difference: −21.3%; 95% CI: −30.3, −13.8).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that switching to a TFV-sparing dual therapy was not associated with an increased risk of virological failure compared with continuing a triple regimen in this population.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that TFV-sparing dual therapy may be a viable option for virologically suppressed people living with HIV and past HBV infection, particularly for those with detectable HBsAb.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate due to the observational emulation of a target trial, which may be subject to residual confounding despite weighted analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study emulated a target trial to compare tenofovir-based triple regimens with tenofovir-sparing dual therapies in 415 virologically suppressed adults living with HIV and past HBV infection. Using a weighted Kaplan–Meier estimator, the analysis found no significant difference in the 5-year risk of virological failure between the two strategies (29.3% vs. 29.9%). However, a higher risk of failure was observed in the subset of participants with undetectable HBsAb at 4 years, regardless of treatment group. The authors conclude that switching to a dual therapy is not associated with increased virological failure risk, suggesting it may be a safe alternative for this patient population.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究比较了基于替诺福韦 (TFV) 的三联疗法与保留 TFV 的双重疗法对既往感染过 HBV(HBsAg−/HBcAb+)且病毒学受到抑制的 HIV 感染者的有效性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究模拟了一项目标试验,包括来自五家大学医院的 415 名 HBsAg−/HBcAb+ 血清状态成人,他们开始使用未抑制血清 HIV-RNA 的三联疗法并达到抑制效果。参与者主要为男性(329 名,79.3%),中位年龄为 48 岁,71 名(17.1%)在随访期间开始接受双重治疗。

elements_zh.main_results: 在加权分析中,双联疗法5年病毒学失败的估计概率为29.3%,三联疗法为29.9%(差异:0.5%;95% CI:-28.7,+21.6)。在 4 年时 HBsAb 检测不到的子集中,双联治疗的发生率为 15.5%,三联治疗的发生率为 36.8%(差异:-21.3%;95% CI:-30.3,-13.8)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,在该人群中,与继续三联疗法相比,改用保留 TFV 的双重疗法与病毒学失败的风险增加无关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,对于病毒学受到抑制的 HIV 感染者和既往 HBV 感染者,尤其是可检测到 HBsAb 的患者,保留 TFV 的双重疗法可能是一种可行的选择。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于目标试验的观察模拟,证据强度中等,尽管进行了加权分析,但可能会受到残留混杂因素的影响。

title: Correlates of hepatitis B virus awareness and disease specific knowledge in Uganda: a meta-analysis and meta-regression of studies published between 2018 and 2025
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major public health challenge in Uganda, where prevalence varies by region and population group despite national vaccination and screening initiatives. Understanding awareness and knowledge levels is essential for guiding HBV prevention and control strategies. This study synthesized available evidence on the correlates of HBV awareness and disease specific knowledge among different Ugandan populations. METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed, African Journals Online (AJOL), and Google Scholar for cross-sectional studies reporting on HBV awareness or disease-specific knowledge in Uganda, published between January 2018 and December 2025. Study selection, data extraction, and quality appraisal were conducted independently by two reviewers using the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical Cross-Sectional Studies. Eighteen studies meeting the eligibility criteria were included in the final synthesis. Pooled estimates of HBV awareness and correlates of disease-specific knowledge were computed using a random-effects model in MedCalc software (version 10.10), with heterogeneity quantified using the I2 statistic. Sources of heterogeneity were explored through subgroup analysis and sensitivity analysis. Meta-regression was performed to examine trends in HBV awareness by region, year of publication, and study population. Publication bias was assessed using Begg's and Egger's tests. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05, and all estimates are reported with 95% confidence intervals. RESULTS: Eighteen studies met the inclusion criteria. The pooled prevalence of HBV awareness was 75.3% (95% CI: 61.5%-86.9%), with substantial heterogeneity observed across regions and population groups (I2=99.24%). Subgroup analysis revealed that awareness was significantly higher in Central Uganda compared to the northern, eastern, and western regions (p < 0.05), and among healthcare workers compared to the general population and antenatal care attendees (p < 0.05). Knowledge of specific HBV domains varied considerably: awareness of the causative agent, screening services, and vaccination availability was significantly higher among knowledgeable participants compared to those with no prior HBV knowledge (p < 0.05), whereas awareness of post-exposure prophylaxis and completion of the full HBV vaccination schedule remained low compared to those who had received at least partial vaccination (p < 0.05). Awareness of key transmission routes including sexual contact, needle sharing, and mother-to-child transmission was moderate, though knowledge of transmission through infected body fluids remained poor. Participants who were of higher education level were more likely to take up vaccination compared to lower education level (p < 0.05), and participants with a positive attitude toward vaccine effectiveness were significantly more likely to be vaccinated compared to those with a negative attitude (p < 0.05). The meta-regression analysis further revealed a paradoxical overall decline in HBV awareness over the study period. CONCLUSION: Critical gaps still persist in HBV awareness and key knowledge areas highlighting the need for alternative strategies tailored to the social dynamics of the current generation during the delivery of health messages. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.

source_records.abstract: BACKGROUND Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major public health challenge in Uganda, where prevalence varies by region and population group despite national vaccination and screening initiatives. Understanding awareness and knowledge levels is essential for guiding HBV prevention and control strategies. This study synthesized available evidence on the correlates of HBV awareness and disease specific knowledge among different Ugandan populations. METHODS We systematically searched PubMed, African Journals Online (AJOL), and Google Scholar for cross-sectional studies reporting on HBV awareness or disease-specific knowledge in Uganda, published between January 2018 and December 2025. Study selection, data extraction, and quality appraisal were conducted independently by two reviewers using the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical Cross-Sectional Studies. Eighteen studies meeting the eligibility criteria were included in the final synthesis. Pooled estimates of HBV awareness and correlates of disease-specific knowledge were computed using a random-effects model in MedCalc software (version 10.10), with heterogeneity quantified using the I2 statistic. Sources of heterogeneity were explored through subgroup analysis and sensitivity analysis. Meta-regression was performed to examine trends in HBV awareness by region, year of publication, and study population. Publication bias was assessed using Begg's and Egger's tests. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05, and all estimates are reported with 95% confidence intervals. RESULTS Eighteen studies met the inclusion criteria. The pooled prevalence of HBV awareness was 75.3% (95% CI: 61.5%-86.9%), with substantial heterogeneity observed across regions and population groups (I2=99.24%). Subgroup analysis revealed that awareness was significantly higher in Central Uganda compared to the northern, eastern, and western regions (p < 0.05), and among healthcare workers compared to the general population and antenatal care attendees (p < 0.05). Knowledge of specific HBV domains varied considerably: awareness of the causative agent, screening services, and vaccination availability was significantly higher among knowledgeable participants compared to those with no prior HBV knowledge (p < 0.05), whereas awareness of post-exposure prophylaxis and completion of the full HBV vaccination schedule remained low compared to those who had received at least partial vaccination (p < 0.05). Awareness of key transmission routes including sexual contact, needle sharing, and mother-to-child transmission was moderate, though knowledge of transmission through infected body fluids remained poor. Participants who were of higher education level were more likely to take up vaccination compared to lower education level (p < 0.05), and participants with a positive attitude toward vaccine effectiveness were significantly more likely to be vaccinated compared to those with a negative attitude (p < 0.05). The meta-regression analysis further revealed a paradoxical overall decline in HBV awareness over the study period. CONCLUSION Critical gaps still persist in HBV awareness and key knowledge areas highlighting the need for alternative strategies tailored to the social dynamics of the current generation during the delivery of health messages. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Critical gaps persist in HBV awareness and key knowledge areas, such as post-exposure prophylaxis and full vaccination schedule completion, despite moderate awareness of transmission routes. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Understanding awareness and knowledge levels is essential for guiding HBV prevention and control strategies. The findings suggest that targeted health education interventions are necessary to address specific knowledge deficits and improve vaccination uptake among different Ugandan populations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate due to the substantial heterogeneity observed across regions and population groups. The study design relied on cross-sectional data, which limits causal inference, and the paradoxical decline in awareness over time warrants further investigation.

analysis.summary_en: This meta-analysis synthesized evidence from eighteen cross-sectional studies to evaluate Hepatitis B virus (HBV) awareness and knowledge correlates in Uganda between 2018 and 2025. The pooled prevalence of HBV awareness was 75.3%, with substantial heterogeneity across regions and populations. Awareness was significantly higher in Central Uganda and among healthcare workers compared to the general population and antenatal care attendees. While knowledge of transmission routes was moderate, critical gaps remained regarding post-exposure prophylaxis and vaccination schedules. Meta-regression indicated a paradoxical overall decline in awareness over the study period. These findings highlight the need for tailored health education strategies to address persistent knowledge deficits and guide effective HBV prevention and control efforts.

title_zh: 乌干达 乙型肝炎病毒 意识与疾病特定知识的相关性:对 2018 年至 2025 年发表的研究进行荟萃分析和荟萃回归
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major public health challenge in Uganda, where prevalence varies by region and population group despite national vaccination and screening initiatives. Understanding awareness and knowledge levels is essential for guiding HBV prevention and control strategies. This study synthesized available evidence on the correlates of HBV awareness and disease specific knowledge among different Ugandan populations. METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed, African Journals Online (AJOL), and Google Scholar for cross-sectional studies reporting on HBV awareness or disease-specific knowledge in Uganda, published between January 2018 and December 2025. Study selection, data extraction, and quality appraisal were conducted independently by two reviewers using the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical Cross-Sectional Studies. Eighteen studies meeting the eligibility criteria were included in the final synthesis. Pooled estimates of HBV awareness and correlates of disease-specific knowledge were computed using a random-effects model in MedCalc software (version 10.10), with heterogeneity quantified using the I2 statistic. Sources of heterogeneity were explored through subgroup analysis and sensitivity analysis. Meta-regression was performed to examine trends in HBV awareness by region, year of publication, and study population. Publication bias was assessed using Begg's and Egger's tests. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05, and all estimates are reported with 95% confidence intervals. RESULTS: Eighteen studies met the inclusion criteria. The pooled prevalence of HBV awareness was 75.3% (95% CI: 61.5%-86.9%), with substantial heterogeneity observed across regions and population groups (I2=99.24%). Subgroup analysis revealed that awareness was significantly higher in Central Uganda compared to the northern, eastern, and western regions (p < 0.05), and among healthcare workers compared to the general population and antenatal care attendees (p < 0.05). Knowledge of specific HBV domains varied considerably: awareness of the causative agent, screening services, and vaccination availability was significantly higher among knowledgeable participants compared to those with no prior HBV knowledge (p < 0.05), whereas awareness of post-exposure prophylaxis and completion of the full HBV vaccination schedule remained low compared to those who had received at least partial vaccination (p < 0.05). Awareness of key transmission routes including sexual contact, needle sharing, and mother-to-child transmission was moderate, though knowledge of transmission through infected body fluids remained poor. Participants who were of higher education level were more likely to take up vaccination compared to lower education level (p < 0.05), and participants with a positive attitude toward vaccine effectiveness were significantly more likely to be vaccinated compared to those with a negative attitude (p < 0.05). The meta-regression analysis further revealed a paradoxical overall decline in HBV awareness over the study period. CONCLUSION: Critical gaps still persist in HBV awareness and key knowledge areas highlighting the need for alternative strategies tailored to the social dynamics of the current generation during the delivery of health messages. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.
abstract_zh: 背景:乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 仍然是乌干达的一个主要公共卫生挑战,尽管有国家 疫苗接种 和筛查举措,但 患病率 因地区和人群而异。了解意识和知识水平对于指导乙肝预防和控制策略至关重要。这项研究综合了乌干达不同人群对乙肝病毒的认识和疾病具体知识之间的相关性的现有证据。方法:我们系统地检索了 PubMed、非洲期刊在线 (AJOL) 和 Google Scholar,查找 2018 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月期间发表的关于乌干达 HBV 认知或特定疾病知识的横断面研究。研究选择、数据提取和质量评估由两名评审员使用 Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) 分析横断面研究批判评估清单独立进行。最终综合报告中纳入了十八项符合资格标准的研究。使用 MedCalc 软件(版本 10.10)中的随机效应模型计算 HBV 认知度和特定疾病知识相关性的汇总估计,并使用 I2 统计量量化异质性。通过亚组分析和敏感性分析探讨异质性的来源。进行元回归以检查按地区、出版年份和研究人群划分的 HBV 认知趋势。使用 Begg 和 Egger 测试评估发表偏倚。统计显着性设置为 p < 0.05,所有估计值均以 95% 置信区间报告。结果:十八项研究符合纳入标准。汇总的 患病率 乙肝病毒知晓率为 75.3%(95% CI:61.5%-86.9%),不同地区和人群之间存在显着异质性(I2=99.24%)。亚组分析显示,与北部、东部和西部地区相比,乌干达中部地区的知晓率显着较高(p < 0.05),与一般人群和产前护理人员相比,医护人员的知晓率显着较高(p < 0.05)。对特定 HBV 领域的了解差异很大:与先前没有 HBV 知识的参与者相比,知识丰富的参与者对病原体、筛查服务和 疫苗接种 可用性的认识显着较高 (p < 0.05),而与至少接受部分 疫苗接种 的参与者相比,对暴露后预防和完成完整 HBV 疫苗接种 时间表的认识仍然较低 (p < 0.05)。对主要 传播 途径(包括性接触、共用针头和母婴 传播)的了解程度中等,但通过感染体液对 传播 的了解仍然很少。与教育水平较低的参与者相比,教育水平较高的参与者更有可能接种 疫苗接种 (p < 0.05),而对 疫苗 有效性持积极态度的参与者比持消极态度的参与者更有可能接种疫苗 (p < 0.05)。荟萃回归分析进一步揭示了研究期间乙肝病毒认知度整体下降的矛盾现象。结论:对乙肝病毒的认识和关键知识领域仍然存在严重差距,这突出表明在传播健康信息时需要针对当代社会动态制定替代策略。临床试验编号:不适用。

title: Enhanced surveillance for hepatitis B and C: insights into clinical care after diagnosis
abstract: BACKGROUND: There are known gaps in care uptake for hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection, and public health surveillance represents an opportunity to support health service engagement for cases; however, specific data are lacking regarding follow-up after diagnosis. We assessed outcomes of a Victorian initiative to enhance data availability and to support linkage to care. METHODS: Notified cases of HBV and HCV within Victoria during 2023-2024 were analysed to determine post-diagnosis follow-up, including variation by demographics and setting, and reported reasons for lack of linkage to care. RESULTS: Information was available for two-thirds of cases. For HBV, 37.7% reported current treatment or management, while 53.6% reported referral or assessment in progress; for HCV, these proportions were 33.3% and 54.7%. Reasons for gaps included loss to follow-up, cost barriers, and misapplication of HBV treatment criteria. DISCUSSION: Cascade of care information can be effectively collected via public health surveillance, and these systems represent an opportunity to support prioritisation of public health follow-up.

Methods Notified cases of HBV and HCV within Victoria during 2023-2024 were analysed to determine post-diagnosis follow-up, including variation by demographics and setting, and reported reasons for lack of linkage to care. Results Information was available for two-thirds of cases. For HBV, 37.7% reported current treatment or management, while 53.6% reported referral or assessment in progress; for HCV, these proportions were 33.3% and 54.7%. Reasons for gaps included loss to follow-up, cost barriers, and misapplication of HBV treatment criteria. Discussion Cascade of care information can be effectively collected via public health surveillance, and these systems represent an opportunity to support prioritisation of public health follow-up.

title: Hepatitis B virus infection with high HBsAg and undetectable DNA levels in untreated blood donors: Viral mechanisms and transfusion safety implications
abstract: BACKGROUND: Blood donor screening occasionally identifies individuals with high HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) levels despite undetectable or extremely low HBV DNA. Molecular basis and transfusion risk of this discordant profile remain unclear. STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: Seventy-five blood donors with HBsAg >100 IU/mL and undetectable or very low HBV DNA (<6 IU/mL), including 39 ID-NAT-nonreactive, were investigated. HBV DNA was further assessed using a second ID-NAT assay, confirmatory PCR following virion concentration, and sequencing. Sequences were compared with those from genotype-matched high-viremia controls. Selected basic core promoter (BCP) and core mutations were introduced into 1.18-mer replication-competent Hepatitis B virus (HBV) plasmids to assess effects on extracellular virion-associated DNA production. RESULTS: Four (5%) samples were nonreactive by the two ID-NAT assays. HBV DNA was confirmed in all donors, often at unquantifiable levels, and all were anti-HBc positive. No consistent molecular signature was identified. Heterogeneous, case-specific mutations were detected in BCP, core, and PreS1, including variants predicted to affect pregenomic RNA transcription, encapsidation, or virion assembly, with no evidence of impaired polymerase activity. In vitro, selected BCP mutations significantly reduced extracellular HBV DNA without affecting HBsAg production. Most core mutations had minimal impact, although two strains carrying cN92T/cM93T or cS170F showed reduced virion-associated DNA. Some constructs exhibited impaired virion secretion or increased naked capsid production. CONCLUSION: HBsAg-positive/low-DNA profile largely reflects chronic inactive infection with minimal viremia. Diverse regulatory and structural mutations may contribute in a multifactorial manner. Persistent viral genomes and residual replication support continued HBsAg screening where NAT sensitivity is suboptimal and anti-HBc testing cannot be implemented.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated 75 blood donors with high HBsAg (>100 IU/mL) and undetectable or very low HBV DNA (<6 IU/mL), including 39 ID-NAT-nonreactive cases. HBV DNA was confirmed in all donors, often at unquantifiable levels, with all testing anti-HBc positive. No consistent molecular signature was identified, but heterogeneous mutations in BCP, core, and PreS1 regions were detected. In vitro experiments showed that selected BCP mutations reduced extracellular HBV DNA without affecting HBsAg production, while some core mutations impaired virion secretion. The authors concluded that this discordant profile reflects chronic inactive infection with minimal viremia, driven by diverse regulatory and structural mutations. The findings support continued HBsAg screening in settings with suboptimal NAT sensitivity and limited anti-HBc testing.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 献血者筛查有时会发现乙肝表面抗原 (HBsAg) 水平较高的个体,尽管乙肝病毒 DNA 无法检测到或极低,但这种不一致特征的分子基础和输血风险仍不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 75 名 HBsAg >100 IU/mL 且 HBV DNA 检测不到或极低 (<6 IU/mL) 的献血者进行了调查,其中包括 39 名 ID-NAT 无反应的献血者。
elements_zh.methods: 使用第二次 ID-NAT 测定、病毒粒子浓缩后的验证性 PCR 和测序进一步评估 HBV DNA;将选定的基本核心启动子 (BCP) 和核心 突变 引入具有复制能力的 HBV 质粒中,以评估对细胞外病毒粒子相关 DNA 产生的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 四个 (5%) 样本在两次 ID-NAT 检测中均无反应;所有捐献者的 HBV DNA 均得到证实,通常处于无法量化的水平,并且全部呈抗 HBc 阳性;没有发现一致的分子特征,但在 BCP、核心和 PreS1 中检测到异质的、病例特异性的 突变。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: HBsAg 阳性/低 DNA 谱在很大程度上反映了具有最小病毒血症的慢性非活动性感染,并且不同的调节和结构 突变 可能以多因素的方式起作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 持续性病毒 基因组 和残留复制支持持续的 HBsAg 筛查,其中 NAT 敏感性次优且无法实施抗 HBc 检测。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究没有发现一致的分子特征,并依赖体外测定来确认 突变 效应,尽管样本量足以满足观察到的结果。

title_zh: 未经治疗的献血者中出现高 HBsAg 和检测不到 DNA 水平的 乙型肝炎病毒 感染:病毒机制和输血安全影响
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Blood donor screening occasionally identifies individuals with high HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) levels despite undetectable or extremely low HBV DNA. Molecular basis and transfusion risk of this discordant profile remain unclear. STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: Seventy-five blood donors with HBsAg >100 IU/mL and undetectable or very low HBV DNA (<6 IU/mL), including 39 ID-NAT-nonreactive, were investigated. HBV DNA was further assessed using a second ID-NAT assay, confirmatory PCR following virion concentration, and sequencing. Sequences were compared with those from genotype-matched high-viremia controls. Selected basic core promoter (BCP) and core mutations were introduced into 1.18-mer replication-competent Hepatitis B virus (HBV) plasmids to assess effects on extracellular virion-associated DNA production. RESULTS: Four (5%) samples were nonreactive by the two ID-NAT assays. HBV DNA was confirmed in all donors, often at unquantifiable levels, and all were anti-HBc positive. No consistent molecular signature was identified. Heterogeneous, case-specific mutations were detected in BCP, core, and PreS1, including variants predicted to affect pregenomic RNA transcription, encapsidation, or virion assembly, with no evidence of impaired polymerase activity. In vitro, selected BCP mutations significantly reduced extracellular HBV DNA without affecting HBsAg production. Most core mutations had minimal impact, although two strains carrying cN92T/cM93T or cS170F showed reduced virion-associated DNA. Some constructs exhibited impaired virion secretion or increased naked capsid production. CONCLUSION: HBsAg-positive/low-DNA profile largely reflects chronic inactive infection with minimal viremia. Diverse regulatory and structural mutations may contribute in a multifactorial manner. Persistent viral genomes and residual replication support continued HBsAg screening where NAT sensitivity is suboptimal and anti-HBc testing cannot be implemented.
abstract_zh: 背景:尽管 HBV DNA 检测不到或极低,但献血者筛查偶尔会发现 HBV 表面抗原 (HBsAg) 水平较高的个体。这种不一致特征的分子基础和输血风险仍不清楚。研究设计和方法:对 75 名 HBsAg >100 IU/mL 且 HBV DNA 检测不到或极低 (<6 IU/mL) 的献血者进行了调查,其中包括 39 名 ID-NAT 无反应性的献血者。使用第二次 ID-NAT 测定、病毒粒子浓缩后的验证性 PCR 和测序进一步评估 HBV DNA。将序列与基因型匹配的高病毒血症对照的序列进行比较。将选定的基本核心启动子 (BCP) 和核心 突变 引入具有复制能力的 1.18 聚体 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 质粒中,以评估对细胞外病毒粒子相关 DNA 产生的影响。结果:两个 ID-NAT 检测中有四个 (5%) 样品没有反应。所有捐献者的 HBV DNA 均得到证实,通常处于无法量化的水平,并且全部呈抗 HBc 阳性。没有发现一致的分子特征。在 BCP、核心和 PreS1 中检测到异质的、病例特异性的 突变,包括预测会影响前基因组 RNA 转录、衣壳化或病毒颗粒组装的变体,没有证据表明聚合酶活性受损。在体外,选定的 BCP 突变 显着减少细胞外 HBV DNA,而不影响 HBsAg 的产生。尽管携带 cN92T/cM93T 或 cS170F 的两种菌株显示病毒体相关 DNA 减少,但大多数核心 突变 的影响很小。一些构建体表现出病毒颗粒分泌受损或裸衣壳产量增加。结论:HBsAg 阳性/低 DNA 谱很大程度上反映了慢性非活动性感染,病毒血症极少。多样化的监管和结构 突变 可能以多因素的方式做出贡献。持续性病毒 基因组 和残留复制支持持续的 HBsAg 筛查,其中 NAT 敏感性次优且无法实施抗 HBc 检测。

title: Structural barriers drive the intention-action gap in hepatitis B prevention among migrants in Shandong Province, China: a triangulated study of serological, spatial, and behavioral data.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health challenge in China. Migrant workers constitute a highly vulnerable population due to high geographic mobility and occupational vulnerability. Despite public health education efforts, a notable intention-action gap disrupts the HBV care cascade. This study integrates serological, spatial, and behavioral data to investigate whether this gap is primarily driven by cognitive deficits or interrupted by underlying structural barriers. METHODS: A triangulated cross-sectional study was conducted in Yantai, China, involving structured questionnaire surveys (N = 1,184) and serological testing (N = 2,364). The spatial distribution of regional anti-HBs positive rates was mapped using Geographic Information Systems (GIS). An adapted Health Belief Model was tested using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) with a Robust Maximum Likelihood estimator to evaluate the disruptive effects of objective structural constraints-specifically, time poverty, economic constraints, and systemic lack of medical insurance. RESULTS: The serologically confirmed anti-HBs positive rate was 51.10% (1,208/2,364), substantially lower than the 70% threshold recommended by the World Health Organization. Spatial analysis revealed significant geographic heterogeneity (χ2 = 74.38, P < 0.001), with higher immunity concentrated in large-scale industrial belts (67.33%) and lower immunity clustered in dispersed service-sector districts (36.81%). SEM results indicated that while external cues strongly predicted HBV knowledge (β = 0.894), knowledge had only a marginal effect on preventive intention (β = 0.192). Preventive intention significantly predicted actual behavior (β = 0.655). However, this motivational process was severely undermined by structural barriers, predominantly time poverty (β = -0.563, P < 0.001), followed by economic constraints (β = -0.278, P < 0.001) and lack of medical insurance (β = -0.056, P = 0.030). CONCLUSIONS: The intention-action gap in HBV prevention among migrant workers is primarily driven by socioeconomic structural barriers-most notably time poverty-while basic HBV knowledge remains a foundational but insufficient condition for preventive action. Achieving the goal of viral hepatitis elimination requires a shift from individual cognitive persuasion to structural interventions, emphasizing workplace-based service delivery, spatially targeted resource allocation, and insurance reforms to alleviate out-of-pocket and opportunity costs.

abstract_zh: 背景:乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染仍然是中国的一个重大公共卫生挑战。由于地域流动性大和职业脆弱性,农民工构成高度弱势群体。尽管做出了公共卫生教育努力,但明显的意图与行动差距扰乱了乙肝护理级联。这项研究整合了血清学、空间和行为数据,以调查这种差距是否主要是由认知缺陷造成的,还是被潜在的结构性障碍所中断。方法:在中国烟台进行了一项三角横断面研究,包括结构化问卷调查(N = 1,184)和血清学检测(N = 2,364)。使用地理信息系统 (GIS) 绘制区域抗 HBs 阳性率的空间分布。使用结构方程模型 (SEM) 和鲁棒最大似然估计器对改编后的健康信念模型进行测试,以评估客观结构约束(特别是时间贫困、经济约束和系统性缺乏医疗保险)的破坏性影响。结果:血清学确诊的抗-HBs阳性率为51.10%(1,208/2,364),远低于世界卫生组织推荐的70%阈值。空间分析显示,地理异质性显着(χ2 = 74.38,P < 0.001),免疫力较高的地区集中在规模较大的工业带(67.33%),免疫力较低的地区集中在分散的服务业区(36.81%)。SEM 结果表明,虽然外部线索强烈预测 HBV 知识(β = 0.894),但知识对预防意图只有边际影响(β = 0.192)。预防意图显着预测实际行为(β = 0.655)。然而,这种激励过程受到结构性障碍的严重破坏,主要是时间贫困(β = -0.563,P < 0.001),其次是经济约束(β = -0.278,P < 0.001)和缺乏医疗保险(β = -0.056,P = 0.030)。结论:农民工乙肝预防的意向与行动差距主要是由社会经济结构性障碍(尤其是时间贫困)造成的,而基本的乙肝知识仍然是预防行动的基础但不充分的条件。实现消除病毒性肝炎的目标需要从个人认知说服转向结构性干预,强调基于工作场所的服务提供、有针对性的空间资源分配以及保险改革,以减轻自付费用和机会成本。

title: Impact of Switching from Tenofovir Disoproxil Fumarate to Tenofovir Alafenamide or Entecavir in Older Patients with Chronic Hepatitis B
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) is highly effective for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) but may induce progressive renal impairment and proximal tubular dysfunction. Switching to tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) or entecavir (ETV) may reduce TDF-related nephrotoxicity. This study evaluated renal and metabolic changes before and after switching from TDF to TAF or ETV in a real-world cohort of older patients. METHODS: This retrospective longitudinal cohort study included adults with CHB who switched from TDF to TAF or ETV at a tertiary center (2012-2023). Eligible patients had ≥ 2 years of TDF treatment and ≥ 2 years of post-switch follow-up. Those with virological failure, major coinfections, or non-HBV-related kidney disease were excluded. Clinical and laboratory data were collected at 6-month intervals from 2 years before to 4 years after switching. Biomarker trajectories were analyzed using linear mixed-effects models with time centered at switch comparing treatments and with multivariable adjustment for key confounders. analysis.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study evaluated renal and metabolic changes in 102 older patients with chronic hepatitis B who switched from tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) to tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) or entecavir (ETV). Despite previous studies suggesting creatinine improvement after switching, this cohort showed no significant reduction in creatinine levels, though an attenuation of progression and phosphate recovery were observed. title_zh: 老年 慢性乙型肝炎 患者从富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯转换为替诺福韦艾拉酚胺或恩替卡韦的影响
source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) is highly effective for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) but may induce progressive renal impairment and proximal tubular dysfunction. Switching to tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) or entecavir (ETV) may reduce TDF-related nephrotoxicity. This study evaluated renal and metabolic changes before and after switching from TDF to TAF or ETV in a real-world cohort of older patients. METHODS: This retrospective longitudinal cohort study included adults with CHB who switched from TDF to TAF or ETV at a tertiary center (2012-2023). Eligible patients had ≥ 2 years of TDF treatment and ≥ 2 years of post-switch follow-up. Those with virological failure, major coinfections, or non-HBV-related kidney disease were excluded. Clinical and laboratory data were collected at 6-month intervals from 2 years before to 4 years after switching. Biomarker trajectories were analyzed using linear mixed-effects models with time centered at switch comparing treatments and with multivariable adjustment for key confounders. RESULTS: A total of 102 patients were included (TAF n = 82; ETV n = 20), mean age 72 ± 10 years, 72% male. All patients had undetectable HBV-DNA at switch. During TDF therapy, serum creatinine showed a non-significant increasing trend (β = + 0.008 mg/dL/year, p = 0.24), which persisted after switching (β = + 0.009 mg/dL/year, p = 0.07), with no significant difference between groups. Serum phosphate declined during TDF in the ETV group (β = - 0.175 mg/dL/year, p = 0.002) and showed a significant increase after switching (β = + 0.111 mg/dL/year, p = 0.031) while the TAF group remained stable throughout. Total cholesterol ishowed a significant immediate increase at the time of switch (+ 18.3 mg/dL, 95% CI 11.0-25.6, p < 0.001), with no significant difference between TAF and ETV. CONCLUSIONS: Unlike previous studies reporting clear creatinine improvement after switching from TDF, this cohort did not show a statistically significant reduction in creatinine levels after the switch although an attenuation of creatinine progression and recovery of phosphate levels were observed, suggesting mitigation of TDF-related renal and tubular toxicity.

title: Chronic HBV Infection Disrupts CCL5‐Secreting cNK Cells and Attenuates Liver Accumulation and Activation of DCs and HBV‐Specific T Cells
abstract: ABSTRACT Understanding the immunological mechanisms underlying chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection‐induced immune tolerance is critical for developing effective therapeutic strategies, yet the mechanisms by which natural killer (NK)‐cell subsets regulate dendritic cell (DC)‐mediated antiviral immunity during chronic HBV infection remain unclear. Here, we demonstrated that chronic HBV infection disrupted intrahepatic DCs accumulation and activation by suppressing CC chemokine ligand 5 (CCL5) production from hepatic NK cells. Importantly, chronic HBV infection reduced the number of hepatic conventional NK (cNK) cells, the main source of hepatic CCL5, whereas liver‐resident NK (LrNK) cells increased and exhibited lower CCL5 expression and immunosuppressive features. Adoptive transfer of CCL5‐competent hepatic cNK cells promoted DCs accumulation and activation, enhanced HBV‐specific CD8 + T‐cell responses, and facilitated viral clearance. Mechanistically, chronic HBV infection promoted the activation of adenosine A2a receptor (ADORA2A)/nuclear factor kappa‐B (NF‐κB) pathway in hepatic NK cells, thereby antagonizing NF‐κB activation, reducing the proportion of cNK cells, suppressing CCL5 production, and ultimately impairing hepatic aggregation and activation of DCs, leading to defective anti‐HBV immune responses. This study revealed a novel mechanism involved in chronic HBV infection‐induced immune tolerance and indicated that targeting the ADORA2A/NFκB/CCL5 axis in cNK cells may represent a potential therapeutic strategy for chronic HBV infection.

Importantly, chronic HBV infection reduced the number of hepatic conventional NK (cNK) cells, the main source of hepatic CCL5, whereas liver-resident NK (LrNK) cells increased and exhibited lower CCL5 expression and immunosuppressive features. Adoptive transfer of CCL5-competent hepatic cNK cells promoted DCs accumulation and activation, enhanced HBV-specific CD8 + T-cell responses, and facilitated viral clearance. Mechanistically, chronic HBV infection promoted the activation of adenosine A2a receptor (ADORA2A)/nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-κB) pathway in hepatic NK cells, thereby antagonizing NF-κB activation, reducing the proportion of cNK cells, suppressing CCL5 production, and ultimately impairing hepatic aggregation and activation of DCs, leading to defective anti-HBV immune responses. This study revealed a novel mechanism involved in chronic HBV infection-induced immune tolerance and indicated that targeting the ADORA2A/NFκB/CCL5 axis in cNK cells may represent a potential therapeutic strategy for chronic HBV infection.

abstract_zh: 摘要 了解 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染诱导的免疫耐受的免疫学机制对于制定有效的治疗策略至关重要,但自然杀伤 (NK) 细胞亚群在慢性 HBV 感染期间调节树突状细胞 (DC) 介导的 抗病毒药物 免疫的机制仍不清楚。在这里,我们证明慢性 HBV 感染通过抑制肝 NK 细胞产生 CC 趋化因子配体 5 (CCL5) 来破坏肝内 DC 的积累和激活。重要的是,慢性 HBV 感染减少了肝脏常规 NK (cNK) 细胞(肝脏 CCL5 的主要来源)的数量,而肝脏驻留 NK (LrNK) 细胞增加并表现出较低的 CCL5 表达和免疫抑制特征。CCL5 活性肝 cNK 细胞的过继转移促进了 DC 的积累和激活,增强了 HBV 特异性 CD8 + T 细胞反应,并促进了病毒清除。从机制上讲,慢性HBV感染促进肝NK细胞中腺苷A2a受体(ADORA2A)/核因子κB(NF-κB)通路的激活,从而拮抗NF-κB激活,降低cNK细胞比例,抑制CCL5产生,最终损害肝脏聚集和DCs激活,导致抗HBV 免疫应答缺陷。这项研究揭示了慢性 HBV 感染诱导的免疫耐受的新机制,并表明靶向 cNK 细胞中的 ADORA2A/NFκB/CCL5 轴可能代表慢性 HBV 感染的潜在治疗策略。

title: Factors Associated With Surface Antigen (HBsAg) Clearance in a Spanish Cohort of Chronic Hepatitis B Patients: Influence on the Long‐Term Prognosis
abstract: ABSTRACT The objective is to identify factors that contribute to hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) clearance in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection in an unselected, long‐term follow‐up hepatitis B open cohort in southern Spain. A prospective open cohort study of 453 patients with CHB infection was recruited in the Liver Unit of the Internal Department of two hospitals in Málaga (Spain) between 1991 and 2022 to assess the incidence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) clearance during follow‐up, identify factors related to it, and determine the influence that clearance had on the long‐term prognosis. The duration of follow‐up ranged from 0.5 to 36.08 years. A multivariate Cox regression analysis was conducted to identify factors associated with HBsAg clearance. The impact of clearance on long‐term prognosis was evaluated using a combined prognostic end point: need for liver transplantation, liver complications, or liver‐related mortality. The construction of time‐to‐event curves was achieved by employing the Kaplan‐Meir method, with subsequent comparison of event occurrence between groups conducted via log‐rank test. During the subsequent follow‐up period, 96/453 patients (21.2%) lost surface antigen (1.96/100 patients per year). Multivariate Cox regression analysis identified as independent factors associated with HBsAg clearance: age at first assessment over 40 years: HR 2.21 (1.38–3.52); a baseline DNA HBV peak below 3.3log 10 (< 2000 IU/mL): HR 3.44 (2.01–5.89); loss of hepatitis B e‐antigen (HBeAg) during follow‐up: HR 7.23 (3.87–13.50). The incidence of HBsAg clearance was 1.96 cases/100 patient‐years. It was more frequent in patients older than 40 years, with baseline DNA‐HBV below 3.3 log 10 (< 2000 IU/mL), and in chronic HBeAg+ patients who lost HBeAg during follow‐up. HBsAg clearance was associated with a better long‐term hepatic prognosis.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated factors associated with hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) clearance in a Spanish cohort of chronic hepatitis B patients and its impact on long-term prognosis. A prospective open cohort study of 453 patients with chronic hepatitis B infection was conducted between 1991 and 2022 in Málaga, Spain. The study used multivariate Cox regression analysis to identify independent factors linked to HBsAg clearance, including age over 40 years, baseline HBV DNA levels below 3.3 log 10, and loss of hepatitis B e-antigen during follow-up. The results showed that 21.2% of patients lost HBsAg, with an incidence rate of 1.96 cases per 100 patient-years. HBsAg clearance was associated with improved long-term hepatic prognosis, as measured by the combined endpoint of liver transplantation, complications, or mortality. The study's evidence is strong due to its large sample size and extended follow-up, though its observational design limits causal inference.

It was more frequent in patients older than 40 years, with baseline DNA‐HBV below 3.3 log 10 (< 2000 IU/mL), and in chronic HBeAg+ patients who lost HBeAg during follow‐up. HBsAg clearance was associated with a better long‐term hepatic prognosis.

title: Medication adherence in Chinese adults with chronic hepatitis B based on theory of planned behavior
abstract: Purpose To investigate the factors related to medication adherence in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection by considering the theory of planned behavior (TPB). Methods In this cross-sectional study, medication adherence information was collected from outpatients with CHB in China. Pearson correlation analysis was performed to evaluate the association between medication adherence and TPB items. A structural equation model was established to further assess the effects of the latent TPB variables on medication adherence. Results A total of 225 patients with CHB recruited from the outpatient department of Qingdao Public Health Clinical Center were included, 67.6% of whom reported moderate medication adherence, as assessed using Morisky Adherence Assessment Score. Medication adherence was significantly positively correlated with behavioral intention ( r = 0.51, P < 0.001), perceived behavioral control ( r = 0.63, P < 0.001), and subjective norms ( r = 0.52, P < 0.001). Perceived behavioral control both directly and indirectly affected medication adherence, with the correlation coefficients being 0.14 and 0.32, respectively. The structural equation model revealed behavioral attitude and subjective norms as the strongest predictors of medication adherence, both of which indirectly affected behavior (correlation coefficients: 0.13 × 0.66 = 0.09 and 0.39 × 0.66 = 0.25, respectively). The optimal fitted model of TPB variables explained 58.5% of the variance in medication adherence. Conclusions Moderate medication adherence was discovered among Chinese adults with CHB. Behavioral attitude, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral control indirectly affected medication adherence.

analysis.methods: Pearson correlation analysis was used to evaluate associations between medication adherence and TPB items, and a structural equation model was established to assess the effects of latent TPB variables on medication adherence.
analysis.main_results: Among 225 patients with CHB, 67.6% reported moderate medication adherence as assessed by the Morisky Adherence Assessment Score. Medication adherence was significantly positively correlated with behavioral intention (r = 0.51, P < 0.001), perceived behavioral control (r = 0.63, P < 0.001), and subjective norms (r = 0.52, P < 0.001).

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform interventions to improve medication adherence in CHB patients by targeting behavioral attitude, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral control based on the TPB framework.

title_zh: 基于计划行为理论的中国成人慢性乙型肝炎的药物依从性
source_body_en: Purpose To investigate the factors related to medication adherence in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection by considering the theory of planned behavior (TPB). Methods In this cross-sectional study, medication adherence information was collected from outpatients with CHB in China. Pearson correlation analysis was performed to evaluate the association between medication adherence and TPB items. A structural equation model was established to further assess the effects of the latent TPB variables on medication adherence. Results A total of 225 patients with CHB recruited from the outpatient department of Qingdao Public Health Clinical Center were included, 67.6% of whom reported moderate medication adherence, as assessed using Morisky Adherence Assessment Score. Medication adherence was significantly positively correlated with behavioral intention ( r = 0.51, P < 0.001), perceived behavioral control ( r = 0.63, P < 0.001), and subjective norms ( r = 0.52, P < 0.001). Perceived behavioral control both directly and indirectly affected medication adherence, with the correlation coefficients being 0.14 and 0.32, respectively. The structural equation model revealed behavioral attitude and subjective norms as the strongest predictors of medication adherence, both of which indirectly affected behavior (correlation coefficients: 0.13 × 0.66 = 0.09 and 0.39 × 0.66 = 0.25, respectively). The optimal fitted model of TPB variables explained 58.5% of the variance in medication adherence. Conclusions Moderate medication adherence was discovered among Chinese adults with CHB. Behavioral attitude, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral control indirectly affected medication adherence.
abstract_zh: 目的 基于计划行为理论(TPB)探讨慢性乙型肝炎(慢性乙型肝炎,CHB)感染患者药物依从性的相关因素。方法 在这项横断面研究中,收集了中国CHB门诊患者的药物依从性信息。采用Pearson相关分析评估药物依从性与TPB项目之间的关联。建立结构方程模型以进一步评估潜在TPB变量对药物依从性的影响。结果 共纳入从青岛市公共卫生临床中心门诊部招募的225例CHB患者,根据Morisky依从性评估量表评估,其中67.6%报告了中等药物依从性。药物依从性与行为意向(r = 0.51,P < 0.001)、感知行为控制(r = 0.63,P < 0.001)和主观规范(r = 0.52,P < 0.001)呈显著正相关。感知行为控制直接和间接影响药物依从性,相关系数分别为0.14和0.32。结构方程模型显示行为态度和主观规范是药物依从性的最强预测因子,两者均间接影响行为(相关系数分别为:0.13 × 0.66 = 0.09 和 0.39 × 0.66 = 0.25)。TPB变量的最佳拟合模型解释了药物依从性58.5%的方差。结论 发现中国CHB成人患者具有中等药物依从性。行为态度、主观规范和感知行为控制间接影响药物依从性。

title: Trends in Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C, and HIV Seroprevalence in the Netherlands: Insights From Two Decades of Nationwide PIENTER Serosurveys.
abstract: Hepatitis B (HBV), hepatitis C (HCV), and HIV remain public health challenges despite effective treatments and preventive options. Infections are often asymptomatic, leading to undiagnosed cases, onward transmission, and preventable morbidity and mortality. In the Netherlands, disease burden is concentrated in specific populations, with many undetected infections. We estimated HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence, identified determinants, and assessed trends over 20 years using data from 14,444 participants aged 15-79 years from three nationwide cross-sectional serosurveys (PIENTER: 1995-1996, 2006-2007, and 2016-2017). Participants completed questionnaires on demographics, behaviour, and socio-economic factors, and serum samples were tested for HBV and HCV in all rounds and HIV in 2017. Seroprevalence estimates were weighted to the Dutch population, trends were analysed using weighted Poisson regression, and determinants were evaluated using multivariable Poisson regression. Weighted HBV seroprevalence remained stable across surveys (3%-5% past or present infection; < 0.4% active infection). HBV prevalence was highest among first-generation migrants, with older age, migration background, and STI history as key determinants. HCV seroprevalence remained low (< 0.4%) and was highest among non-Western migrants. HIV prevalence was 0.1% and highest among non-Western migrants and men who have sex with men. Only 9% of active HBV cases were aware of their status. Overall, HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence remain low in the Netherlands but are concentrated in specific groups with limited awareness. These findings support targeted prevention, screening, and linkage-to-care strategies to achieve the 2030 WHO elimination goals and highlight the importance of continued population-based (sero-)monitoring to guide public health policy.

Eline L M Op de Coul
Christine G J I van Straten

In the Netherlands, the disease burden is concentrated in specific populations with many undetected infections, necessitating an assessment of seroprevalence trends over time.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study utilized data from three nationwide cross-sectional serosurveys (PIENTER: 1995-1996, 2006-2007, and 2016-2017) including 14,444 participants aged 15-79 years to estimate HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence, identify determinants, and assess trends over 20 years.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed three nationwide cross-sectional serosurveys (PIENTER) from 1995-1996, 2006-2007, and 2016-2017, involving 14,444 participants aged 15-79 years, to assess trends in HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence in the Netherlands. Weighted analyses showed that HBV seroprevalence remained stable (3%-5% past or present infection; < 0.4% active infection), HCV stayed low (< 0.4%), and HIV prevalence was 0.1%. Infections were concentrated among first-generation and non-Western migrants and men who have sex with men, with only 9% of active HBV cases aware of their status. These findings support targeted prevention and screening strategies to achieve WHO elimination goals and underscore the need for continued population-based monitoring.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管有有效的 传播 和预防措施,乙型肝炎 (HBV)、丙型肝炎 (HCV) 和 HIV 仍然是公共卫生挑战,感染通常无症状,导致未确诊病例和进一步的 传播。在荷兰,疾病负担集中在特定人群中,有许多未发现的感染,因此需要对 血清流行率 随着时间的推移的趋势进行评估。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用了三项全国性横断面血清调查(PIENTER:1995-1996、2006-2007 和 2016-2017)的数据,包括 14,444 名 15-79 岁的参与者,以估计 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 血清流行率、确定决定因素并评估 20 年来的趋势。
elements_zh.methods: 参与者完成了有关人口统计、行为和社会经济因素的问卷调查,并在 2017 年对所有轮次的 HBV 和 HCV 以及 HIV 样本进行了血清样本检测。血清流行率 估计值根据荷兰人口进行加权,使用加权泊松回归分析趋势,并使用多变量泊松回归评估决定因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 加权 HBV 血清流行率 在整个调查中保持稳定(3%-5% 过去或现在感染;< 0.4% 活动性感染),在第一代移民中最高,只有 9% 的活动性 HBV 病例知道自己的状况。HCV 血清流行率 仍然较低(< 0.4%),在非西方移民中最高,而 HIV 患病率 为 0.1%,在非西方移民和男男性行为者中最高。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 总体而言,荷兰的HBV、HCV和HIV 血清流行率仍然较低,但集中在认知有限的特定群体中,这表明虽然一般人群患病率稳定,但在这些亚群中存在持续的传播风险。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持有针对性的预防、筛查和与护理挂钩的战略,以实现世卫组织 2030 年消除目标,并强调持续进行基于人群的(血清)监测以指导公共卫生政策的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据没有报告具体的设计限制、偏差或混杂因素,但使用二十年来三项大规模全国性调查的加权数据为评估人口趋势提供了中等水平的证据。

title_zh: 荷兰乙型肝炎、丙型肝炎和 HIV 血清流行率 的趋势:二十年全国 PIENTER 血清调查的见解。
source_body_en: Hepatitis B (HBV), hepatitis C (HCV), and HIV remain public health challenges despite effective treatments and preventive options. Infections are often asymptomatic, leading to undiagnosed cases, onward transmission, and preventable morbidity and mortality. In the Netherlands, disease burden is concentrated in specific populations, with many undetected infections. We estimated HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence, identified determinants, and assessed trends over 20 years using data from 14,444 participants aged 15-79 years from three nationwide cross-sectional serosurveys (PIENTER: 1995-1996, 2006-2007, and 2016-2017). Participants completed questionnaires on demographics, behaviour, and socio-economic factors, and serum samples were tested for HBV and HCV in all rounds and HIV in 2017. Seroprevalence estimates were weighted to the Dutch population, trends were analysed using weighted Poisson regression, and determinants were evaluated using multivariable Poisson regression. Weighted HBV seroprevalence remained stable across surveys (3%-5% past or present infection; < 0.4% active infection). HBV prevalence was highest among first-generation migrants, with older age, migration background, and STI history as key determinants. HCV seroprevalence remained low (< 0.4%) and was highest among non-Western migrants. HIV prevalence was 0.1% and highest among non-Western migrants and men who have sex with men. Only 9% of active HBV cases were aware of their status. Overall, HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence remain low in the Netherlands but are concentrated in specific groups with limited awareness. These findings support targeted prevention, screening, and linkage-to-care strategies to achieve the 2030 WHO elimination goals and highlight the importance of continued population-based (sero-)monitoring to guide public health policy.
abstract_zh: 尽管采取了有效的 治疗 和预防措施,乙型肝炎 (HBV)、丙型肝炎 (HCV) 和艾滋病毒仍然是公共卫生挑战。感染通常是无症状的,导致未确诊病例、传播 以及可预防的发病率和 传播。在荷兰,疾病负担集中在特定人群,有许多感染未被发现。我们使用来自三项全国性横断面血清调查(PIENTER:1995-1996、2006-2007 和 2016-2017)的 14,444 名 15-79 岁参与者的数据估计了 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 血清流行率,确定了决定因素并评估了 20 年来的趋势。参与者完成了有关人口统计、行为和社会经济因素的问卷调查,并在 2017 年对所有轮次的 HBV 和 HCV 以及 HIV 样本进行了血清样本检测。血清流行率 估计值根据荷兰人口进行加权,使用加权泊松回归分析趋势,并使用多变量泊松回归评估决定因素。加权 HBV 血清流行率 在整个调查中保持稳定(3%-5% 过去或现在的感染;< 0.4% 活动感染)。乙型肝炎病毒 患病率 在第一代流动人口中最高,年龄、流动背景和性传播感染史是关键决定因素。HCV 血清流行率 仍然较低(< 0.4%),并且在非西方移民中最高。HIV 患病率 为 0.1%,在非西方移民和男男性行为者中感染率最高。只有 9% 的活动性 HBV 病例知道自己的状况。总体而言,荷兰的 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 血清流行率 仍然处于较低水平,但集中在意识有限的特定群体中。这些发现支持有针对性的预防、筛查和与护理挂钩的战略,以实现世卫组织 2030 年消除目标,并强调持续进行基于人群的(血清)监测以指导公共卫生政策的重要性。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管有有效的 传播 和预防措施,乙型肝炎 (HBV)、丙型肝炎 (HCV) 和 HIV 仍然是公共卫生挑战,感染通常无症状,导致未确诊病例和进一步的 传播。在荷兰,疾病负担集中在特定人群中,有许多未发现的感染,因此需要对 血清流行率 随着时间的推移的趋势进行评估。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用了三项全国性横断面血清调查(PIENTER:1995-1996、2006-2007 和 2016-2017)的数据,包括 14,444 名 15-79 岁的参与者,以估计 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 血清流行率、确定决定因素并评估 20 年来的趋势。
analysis_zh.methods: 参与者完成了有关人口统计、行为和社会经济因素的问卷调查,并在 2017 年对所有轮次的 HBV 和 HCV 以及 HIV 样本进行了血清样本检测。血清流行率 估计值根据荷兰人口进行加权,使用加权泊松回归分析趋势,并使用多变量泊松回归评估决定因素。
analysis_zh.main_results: 加权 HBV 血清流行率 在整个调查中保持稳定(3%-5% 过去或现在感染;< 0.4% 活动性感染),在第一代移民中最高,只有 9% 的活动性 HBV 病例知道自己的状况。HCV 血清流行率 仍然较低(< 0.4%),在非西方移民中最高,而 HIV 患病率 为 0.1%,在非西方移民和男男性行为者中最高。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 总体而言,荷兰的HBV、HCV和HIV 血清流行率仍然较低,但集中在认知有限的特定群体中,这表明虽然一般人群患病率稳定,但在这些亚群中存在持续的传播风险。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持有针对性的预防、筛查和与护理挂钩的战略,以实现世卫组织 2030 年消除目标,并强调持续进行基于人群的(血清)监测以指导公共卫生政策的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据没有报告具体的设计限制、偏差或混杂因素,但使用二十年来三项大规模全国性调查的加权数据为评估人口趋势提供了中等水平的证据。

title: Spatiotemporal evolution characteristics and influencing factors of hepatitis B incidence rate in China
abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a persistent public health challenge in China, with significant spatiotemporal heterogeneity in incidence. This study aimed to examine regional disparities in hepatitis B incidence, explore its spatiotemporal evolution patterns, and analyze the spatiotemporal heterogeneity of associated factors across China, using incidence data from 2008 to 2023. The Dagum Gini coefficient decomposition method assessed regional disparity sources, the standard deviation ellipse explored spatiotemporal direction and global characteristics, exploratory spatial data analysis (ESDA) examined spatial correlation and aggregation, and the geographically and temporally weighted regression (GTWR) model was used to examine spatiotemporal heterogeneity of influencing factors. Results showed narrowing regional disparities, declining spatial aggregation, and a standard deviation ellipse located in eastern and central regions with a southeastward shift, alongside the incidence gravity center moving 351.25 km southeast. Patterns shifted from clustered to dispersed, likely due to vaccination and improved healthcare allocation. Six socioeconomic factors exerted significant yet spatiotemporally heterogeneous impacts, with diverse, regionally varying effects based on economic and policy contexts.

title: Long-Term Outcomes of Entecavir Therapy in Treatment-Naive Patients with Chronic Hepatitis B
abstract: Abstract Background Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) requires long-term antiviral therapy to prevent disease progression. This study evaluated the long-term efficacy and safety of entecavir (ETV) therapy and investigated predictors of partial virological response (PVR) in treatment-naive CHB patients. Methods This retrospective study included 230 nucleoside-naive CHB patients treated with entecavir between January 2020 and December 2024. Virological response (VR) was defined as HBV-DNA 1 log10 IU/mL reduction in HBV-DNA despite detectable viral DNA after at least 12 months of therapy. Clinical, biochemical, and virological parameters were analyzed during follow-up. Results The mean age was 44 ± 18 years, and 54.7% were male. Baseline HBV-DNA was 6.8 log10 IU/mL. VR rates reached 66% at month 3, 86% at month 6, 89% at year 1, and 100% by years 4–5. ALT normalization improved progressively, while HBeAg seroconversion was highest during years 2–3. PVR occurred in 10.2% of patients. PVR was significantly associated with higher baseline HBV-DNA levels and failure to achieve virological response VR at week 24. No serious adverse events were observed. Conclusions ETV therapy provides effective, durable viral suppression and excellent safety in treatment-naive CHB patients. Continued treatment in patients with PVR may still achieve complete virological suppression.

title: Longitudinal Patterns of Chronic Hepatitis B Care and Treatment Adherence in Australia: A National Linked Data Cohort Study.
abstract: Current uptake of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) treatment and care in Australia is well below target levels, leading to an ongoing burden of preventable liver disease and cancer. Understanding individual-level trajectories of care engagement and variation by sociodemographic factors is essential to guide efforts to improve access to and retention in care. This study analysed records of hepatitis B viral load (VL) testing and antiviral treatment provided through Australia's national health insurance system, which were linked to migration, death, and sociodemographic data from various government datasets. Treatment and VL testing by population group were assessed, and uptake was calculated using modelled estimates of the number living with CHB. VL testing frequency and treatment adherence based on scripts dispensed were also assessed. Of the estimated 219,800 people living with CHB in Australia in 2023, 118,334 (53.8%) received either VL testing or treatment during 2014-2023. Estimated uptake of VL testing and treatment uptake were lower among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and also varied by region of birth. Of the 81,360 who received any VL testing, only 17,352 (21.3%) received it regularly, while 31,715 (39.0%) had evidence of prior monitoring but no VL testing since 2019. The majority of those who initiated treatment continued therapy and received supply sufficient for adherence. This study shows that substantial gaps exist in CHB care in Australia, particularly in continued monitoring among those not on treatment. Disparities in uptake are evident by priority population. Re-engaging those lost to follow-up should be prioritised.

This study analysed records of hepatitis B viral load (VL) testing and antiviral treatment provided through Australia's national health insurance system, which were linked to migration, death, and sociodemographic data from various government datasets. Treatment and VL testing by population group were assessed, and uptake was calculated using modelled estimates of the number living with CHB. VL testing frequency and treatment adherence based on scripts dispensed were also assessed. Of the estimated 219,800 people living with CHB in Australia in 2023, 118,334 (53.8%) received either VL testing or treatment during 2014-2023. Estimated uptake of VL testing and treatment uptake were lower among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and also varied by region of birth. Of the 81,360 who received any VL testing, only 17,352 (21.3%) received it regularly, while 31,715 (39.0%) had evidence of prior monitoring but no VL testing since 2019. The majority of those who initiated treatment continued therapy and received supply sufficient for adherence. This study shows that substantial gaps exist in CHB care in Australia, particularly in continued monitoring among those not on treatment. Disparities in uptake are evident by priority population. Re-engaging those lost to follow-up should be prioritised.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the patterns of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) care and treatment adherence in Australia using national health insurance and government datasets. It highlights that current treatment and care uptake is below target levels, contributing to preventable liver disease and cancer. The analysis reveals disparities in VL testing and treatment among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander populations and by region of birth. While the majority of those who initiated treatment continued therapy, significant gaps in monitoring persist for those not on treatment. These findings underscore the need for targeted interventions to improve care and retention, particularly for vulnerable groups. The study's reliance on modelled estimates and linked data may limit the precision of its conclusions, but the evidence is strong enough to identify critical areas for public health action.

title: Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk Between Untreated Immune Tolerant Vs. Treated Immune Active Chronic Hepatitis B Patients.
abstract: The risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) between chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients in the untreated immune tolerant (U-IT) vs. treated immune active (T-IA) phases is not clear, and most data are in Asian populations. We aim to evaluate long-term risks of cirrhosis, HCC, and overall mortality between U-IT vs. T-IA CHB patients among a national cohort of U.S. We conducted a propensity score weighted analysis of Veterans with CHB who met criteria for U-IT or T-IA from 1/1/2010 to 12/31/2021 (with follow-up through 12/31/2024). Incidence of cirrhosis, HCC, or death were compared between U-IT and T-IA groups. A total of 591 U-IT and 555 T-IA CHB patients were identified (mean age 56.4-57.5 years, 45%-50% non-Hispanic white, 37%-40% African American, 9%-10% Asian, 25%-29% concurrent diabetes, 35%-39% with FIB-4 > 3.25). Over a median follow up of 6.4 years (IQR 3.0-10.4), incidence of HCC was significantly lower in U-IT patients vs. T-IA patients (0.28 vs. 0.54 per 100 person-years; HR 0.52, 95% CI 0.32-0.83, p = 0.007). However, the risk of cirrhosis or all-cause mortality was similar between both T-IA and U-IT CHB patients. Among a predominantly non-Asian cohort of adults with CHB, we observed that HCC risk was lower in U-IT patients compared to T-IA patients. While this contrasts with some studies in Asian countries, these data do emphasize the importance of prioritizing and ensuring timely therapy for CHB patients in the IA phase. However, routine treatment in IT patients remains controversial and more data are needed to better understand long-term outcomes.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者在未经治疗的免疫耐受 (U-IT) 与治疗的免疫活跃 (T-IA) 阶段发生肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的风险尚不清楚,并且大多数数据来自亚洲人群。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们对 2010 年 1 月 1 日至 2021 年 12 月 31 日期间符合 U-IT 或 T-IA 标准的慢性乙型肝炎退伍军人进行了倾向评分加权分析(随访至 2024 年 12 月 31 日)。总共确定了 591 名 U-IT 和 555 名 T-IA CHB 患者。
elements_zh.methods: 使用倾向评分加权分析比较 U-IT 组和 T-IA 组之间的肝硬化、HCC 或死亡的 发病率。
elements_zh.main_results: Over a median follow up of 6.4 years (IQR 3.0-10.4), incidence of HCC was significantly lower in U-IT patients vs. T-IA patients (0.28 vs. 0.54 per 100 person-years; HR 0.52, 95% CI 0.32-0.83, p = 0.007). However, the risk of cirrhosis or all-cause mortality was similar between both T-IA and U-IT CHB patients.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在主要为非亚裔的慢性乙型肝炎成人 队列研究 中,我们观察到与 T-IA 患者相比,U-IT 患者的 HCC 风险较低。虽然这与亚洲国家的一些研究形成鲜明对比,但这些数据确实强调了在 IA 阶段优先考虑并确保及时治疗 CHB 患者的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了在免疫活跃期及时治疗慢性乙型肝炎患者的重要性,尽管免疫耐受患者的常规 治疗 仍存在争议,并且需要更多数据来更好地了解长期结果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在主要非亚洲人 队列研究 中进行的,这可能会限制对亚洲人群的普遍适用性。尽管有倾向评分加权,但由于观察设计和潜在的残留混杂因素,证据强度中等。

title: LIMITED DIAGNOSTIC ACCURACY OF FIB-4 FOR DETECTING SIGNIFICANT LIVER FIBROSIS IN CHRONIC HEPATITIS B: A CROSS-SECTIONAL STUDY.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Liver disease linked to the hepatitis B virus (HBV) is a serious public threat worldwide and in Egypt. The incidence of HBV infection in Egypt is about 1.4%. Accurate liver fibrosis assessments are crucial in the evaluation and follow-up of HBV patients, but traditional biopsies have limitations, prompting the use of non-invasive methods like the vibration controlled transient elastography (VCTE), which may not be available in limited-resource treatment centers. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to assess the diagnostic accuracy of Fibrosis-4 (FIB-4) and Aminotransferase to Platelet Ratio Index (APRI) compared to VCTE in detecting significant liver fibrosis in adult chronic HBV patients, potentially offering a more accessible and less costly approach to disease management. Methods - In this cross-sectional study, 247 subjects with chronic HBV from Alexandria University Viral Hepatitis Treatment Unit were included. Data collected included demographic details, HBV viral load, liver function tests, Complete Blood Count (CBC), international normalized ratio (INR), prothrombin time, albumin, total and direct bilirubin, APRI score, FIB-4 score, imaging, and VCTE data. IBM SPSS software was used for statistical analysis, with qualitative and quantitative data described appropriately. Logistic regression and receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC) curves were used to identify significant predictors of advanced fibrosis and assess diagnostic performance. RESULTS: Based on VCTE results, 247 chronic hepatitis B patients were classified into two groups: 140 with no or mild fibrosis (F0/1) and 107 with significant fibrosis (F2-F4). Significant differences were found in hemoglobin, albumin, and INR levels between the groups. The FIB-4 and APRI scores were significantly higher in the significant fibrosis group, with median FIB-4 scores of 1.26 vs 0.79 and median APRI scores of 0.40 vs 0.27. The FIB-4 index remained a significant predictor of significant fibrosis in multivariate analysis, with an odds ratio of 1.558. At a cut-off value of >0.88, the FIB-4 score achieved a sensitivity of 65.42% and a specificity of 60.0% in differentiating patients with and without significant fibrosis. CONCLUSION: Although the use of FIB-4 score is potentially useful in resource-limited settings, a significant number of misclassifications can occur due to its moderate sensitivity and specificity which necessitate further incorporation of additional diagnostic methods to ensure the accurate staging of liver fibrosis.

abstract_original: BACKGROUND: Liver disease linked to the hepatitis B virus (HBV) is a serious public threat worldwide and in Egypt. The incidence of HBV infection in Egypt is about 1.4%. Accurate liver fibrosis assessments are crucial in the evaluation and follow-up of HBV patients, but traditional biopsies have limitations, prompting the use of non-invasive methods like the vibration controlled transient elastography (VCTE), which may not be available in limited-resource treatment centers. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to assess the diagnostic accuracy of Fibrosis-4 (FIB-4) and Aminotransferase to Platelet Ratio Index (APRI) compared to VCTE in detecting significant liver fibrosis in adult chronic HBV patients, potentially offering a more accessible and less costly approach to disease management. Methods - In this cross-sectional study, 247 subjects with chronic HBV from Alexandria University Viral Hepatitis Treatment Unit were included. Data collected included demographic details, HBV viral load, liver function tests, Complete Blood Count (CBC), international normalized ratio (INR), prothrombin time, albumin, total and direct bilirubin, APRI score, FIB-4 score, imaging, and VCTE data. IBM SPSS software was used for statistical analysis, with qualitative and quantitative data described appropriately. Logistic regression and receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC) curves were used to identify significant predictors of advanced fibrosis and assess diagnostic performance. RESULTS: Based on VCTE results, 247 chronic hepatitis B patients were classified into two groups: 140 with no or mild fibrosis (F0/1) and 107 with significant fibrosis (F2-F4). Significant differences were found in hemoglobin, albumin, and INR levels between the groups. The FIB-4 and APRI scores were significantly higher in the significant fibrosis group, with median FIB-4 scores of 1.26 vs 0.79 and median APRI scores of 0.40 vs 0.27. The FIB-4 index remained a significant predictor of significant fibrosis in multivariate analysis, with an odds ratio of 1.558. At a cut-off value of >0.88, the FIB-4 score achieved a sensitivity of 65.42% and a specificity of 60.0% in differentiating patients with and without significant fibrosis. CONCLUSION: Although the use of FIB-4 score is potentially useful in resource-limited settings, a significant number of misclassifications can occur due to its moderate sensitivity and specificity which necessitate further incorporation of additional diagnostic methods to ensure the accurate staging of liver fibrosis.

title: High Rates of Advanced Chronic Liver Disease in Patients With Chronic Hepatitis D Virus Infection in Uzbekistan.
abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is endemic in Uzbekistan. Previous data showed a high prevalence of anti-hepatitis D virus (HDV) antibodies in HBsAg-positive individuals. Limited data are available on disease severity, treatment availability and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) prevalence in patients with chronic HDV infection in Uzbekistan. METHODS: The Scientific Research Institute of Virology (SRIoV) is the leading medical and scientific reference centre for viral hepatitis in Uzbekistan. In this retrospective study, epidemiological, clinical and laboratory data were collected and analysed from all HBsAg-positive patients presenting to the SRIoV between June 2023 and May 2024. Data from HDV-coinfected and HBV-monoinfected patients were compared. RESULTS: Data of 1393 individual patients were included. HDV coinfection was more prevalent than HBV-monoinfection (73.9% [n = 1030/1393]) vs. 26.1% [n = 363/1393]. HDV-infected patients were significantly younger (41.9 vs. 45.4, p upper limit of normal. The HCC detection rate was low in both patient groups due to insufficient screening measures (HDV: n = 7/1030, HBV: n = 11/363). CONCLUSIONS: In this retrospective cohort of 1393 individual patients, HDV coinfection exceeds HBV monoinfection in prevalence and disease severity. Most HDV-infected patients present with advanced liver disease and currently lack access to HDV-directed therapy.

abstract_zh: 背景和目的:慢性乙型肝炎 病毒(HBV)感染在乌兹别克斯坦流行。先前的数据显示,HBsAg 阳性个体的抗丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 抗体 患病率 较高。关于乌兹别克斯坦慢性 HDV 感染患者的疾病严重程度、治疗 可用性和肝细胞癌 (HCC) 患病率 的数据有限。方法:病毒学科学研究所 (SRIOV) 是乌兹别克斯坦领先的病毒性肝炎医学和科学参考中心。在这项回顾性研究中,收集并分析了 2023 年 6 月至 2024 年 5 月期间所有就诊于 SRIoV 的 HBsAg 阳性患者的流行病学、临床和实验室数据。比较了 HDV 合并感染和 HBV 单一感染患者的数据。结果:纳入了 1393 名患者的数据。HDV 合并感染比 HBV 单一感染更为普遍 (73.9% [n = 1030/1393]) vs. 26.1% [n = 363/1393]。HDV 感染患者明显年轻(41.9 vs. 45.4,p 正常值上限。由于筛查措施不足,两个患者组的 HCC 检出率均较低(HDV:n = 7/1030,HBV:n = 11/363)。结论:在这项针对 1393 名患者的回顾性 队列研究 中,HDV 合并感染超过 HBV 单一感染患病率 和疾病严重程度。大多数 HDV 感染患者患有晚期肝病,目前缺乏针对 HDV 的治疗。

title: Innovative Multisectoral Approaches to Overcome Hepatitis B Elimination Barriers in Indonesia: Systematic Literature Review
abstract: This study aims to identify the main challenges and multisectoral strategies in hepatitis B elimination efforts in Indonesia, using a global, evidence-based systematic literature review approach.This study was motivated by the high prevalence of chronic hepatitis B and the slow progress in achieving the World Health Organization elimination target of 2030.The literature search was conducted in the Scopus database using the keywords "hepatitis B elimination", "Indonesia", and "multisectoral challenges", covering publications between 2019 and 2025.The analysis followed the PRISMA 2020 guidelines and comprised four main stages: identification, screening, eligibility assessment, and inclusion.Of the initial 135 articles, 20 studies met the criteria and were thematically analyzed to identify trends, challenges, and elimination strategies.The synthesis identified three main dimensions of barriers: (1) biomedical, including limited detection of latent infection (occult hepatitis B infection) and the presence of covalently closed circular DNA; (2) health-system, including weak surveillance, poor cross-program coordination, and manual reporting; and (3) social, including stigma and low vaccination awareness.On the other hand, innovative strategies such as the implementation of digital surveillance systems, the strengthening of cross-country networks, and the development of national vaccines with high effectiveness show the potential to accelerate elimination.This study emphasizes the need for an integrative, cross-sectoral, and evidence-based approach to achieve hepatitis B elimination in Indonesia.The results make conceptual and practical contributions to strengthening global public health policy, particularly in developing countries.

title: Multi-omics and artificial intelligence nominate PCLAF as a prognostic and druggable target for hepatitis B virus-associated hepatocellular carcinoma.
abstract: BACKGROUND: PCLAF (PCNA clamp-associated factor) is a protein involved in DNA replication and DNA repair. Aberrant PCLAF expression has been reported in multiple malignancies and is associated with tumor progression and poor clinical outcomes. However, the biological role of PCLAF in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains incompletely understood, particularly with respect to its relationship with the tumor immune microenvironment. Therefore, this study aimed to systematically investigate the clinical significance, biological functions, and therapeutic potential of PCLAF in HCC through integrated multi-omics analyses, experimental validation, and drug screening approaches. METHODS: In this study, an integrative multi-omics framework was employed to systematically investigate the molecular characteristics and biological functions of PCLAF in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Transcriptomic datasets from the GEO database (GSE83148 and GSE121248) and the TCGA-LIHC cohort were analyzed to identify differentially expressed genes, followed by protein-protein interaction network construction and machine learning algorithms to screen and validate key hub genes. Pan-cancer analysis, clinicopathological correlation analysis, survival analysis, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis were subsequently performed to evaluate the clinical significance of PCLAF. Single-cell RNA sequencing data (GSE202642) were analyzed to characterize the cellular heterogeneity of hepatitis B virus-associated HCC and identify PCLAF-associated cell populations. Functional module scoring and gene set enrichment analysis were performed to investigate the biological features of Cycling T cells. Spatial transcriptomic data (GSE245908) were integrated with deconvolution, cell-cell communication, and spatial regulatory analyses to explore the spatial distribution patterns and intercellular interactions associated with PCLAF. To identify potential therapeutic agents targeting PCLAF, virtual drug screening, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations were conducted. Finally, clinical specimens and HCC cell lines were used for experimental validation. Immunohistochemistry, RT-qPCR, western blotting, colony formation, wound-healing, Transwell migration, and CCK-8 assays were performed to evaluate the effects of PCLAF on HCC cell proliferation and migration. RESULTS: Through integrated transcriptomic analysis, protein-protein interaction network construction, and machine learning approaches, PCLAF was identified as a key candidate gene associated with HCC. Pan-cancer and clinical analyses demonstrated that elevated PCLAF expression was associated with advanced tumor stage, higher pathological grade, and poor prognosis across multiple cancer types. Single-cell transcriptomic analysis revealed that PCLAF was predominantly enriched in Cycling T cells. Functional characterization showed that Cycling T cells exhibited a hyperproliferative but functionally restricted phenotype, characterized by enhanced proliferation accompanied by reduced activation and cytotoxicity. Spatial transcriptomic and cell-cell communication analyses further identified a potential epithelial cell-Cycling T cell interaction network, in which the MIF-CD74-CXCR4 signaling axis represented a major communication pathway. To explore therapeutic opportunities, AI-assisted drug screening, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations were performed, leading to the identification of BRD-K12189280 as a promising candidate compound targeting PCLAF. Experimental validation confirmed that PCLAF was significantly overexpressed in HCC tissues, and its knockdown markedly inhibited the proliferation, migration, and viability of HCC cells in vitro. CONCLUSION: Our findings demonstrate that PCLAF is significantly upregulated in HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma and promotes malignant cellular phenotypes. Multi-omics analyses revealed a close association between PCLAF expression and a hyperproliferative but functionally restricted Cycling T-cell state, highlighting a potential link between tumor progression and immune microenvironment remodeling. These results identify PCLAF as a promising prognostic biomarker and therapeutic target in HCC, while BRD-K12189280 emerges as a potential candidate compound for future drug development.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: PCLAF 是一种参与 DNA 复制和修复的蛋白质,虽然其异常表达与恶性肿瘤有关,但其在肝细胞癌 (HCC) 中的生物学作用仍不完全清楚,特别是在肿瘤免疫微环境方面。本研究旨在通过综合多组学分析、实验验证和药物筛选方法,系统研究 PCLAF 在 HCC 中的临床意义、生物学功能和治疗潜力。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用了综合多组学框架,使用来自 GEO 数据库(GSE83148 和 GSE121248)的转录组数据集、TCGA-LIHC 队列研究、单细胞 RNA 测序数据(GSE202642)和空间转录组数据(GSE245908)。该研究包括泛癌分析、临床病理学相关性、生存分析以及使用临床标本和 HCC 细胞系的验证。
elements_zh.methods: 作者进行了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络构建、机器学习算法和基因集富集分析,以识别和表征关键的枢纽基因。为了评估生物功能和治疗潜力,他们利用了免疫组织化学、RT-qPCR、蛋白质印迹、集落形成、伤口愈合、Transwell 迁移、CCK-8 检测以及通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟进行的人工智能辅助虚拟药物筛选。
elements_zh.main_results: PCLAF被确定为与HCC相关的关键候选基因,其表达升高与肿瘤分期晚期、病理分级较高和预后不良相关。单细胞分析显示 PCLAF 主要富集于表现出过度增殖但功能受限表型的循环 T 细胞,空间分析通过 MIF-CD74-CXCR4 轴确定了上皮细胞-循环 T 细胞相互作用网络。实验验证证实 PCLAF 在 HCC 组织中过度表达,并表明其敲低可抑制增殖、迁移和活力,而 BRD-K12189280 被认为是一种有前途的候选化合物。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,PCLAF 在 HBV 相关肝细胞癌中显着上调,并促进恶性细胞表型。该研究强调了 PCLAF 表达与过度增殖但功能受限的循环 T 细胞状态之间的新联系,表明肿瘤进展与免疫微环境重塑之间存在联系。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果表明 PCLAF 是 HCC 中有前途的预后生物标志物和治疗靶点,而 BRD-K12189280 则成为未来药物开发的潜在候选化合物。该研究提供了对肿瘤进展与免疫微环境之间相互作用的见解,这可能为未来的治疗策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告具体的设计限制、偏见、混杂因素或证据强度的详细评估。该研究仅依赖于抽象证据,这限制了评估研究结果的完整方法论严谨性和普遍性的能力。
